# Bundled fonts

These unmodified Latin variable WOFF2 subsets are served by the embedded app;
no external request is made when the control plane opens. Other scripts fall
back to the user's installed fonts. Total font data is approximately 147 KB.

Retrieved 2026-09-14 from Google Fonts' CSS API using these families/axes:

- Bricolage Grotesque: opsz 12–96, wght 200–800 (Google Fonts v9).
- Geist: wght 100–900 (v5).
- JetBrains Mono: wght 100–800 (v24).

Sources:

- https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/bricolagegrotesque/v9/3y9K6as8bTXq_nANBjzKo3IeZx8z6up5BeSl9D4dj_x9PpZBMlGIInHWVyNJ.woff2
- https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/geist/v5/gyByhwUxId8gMEwcGFWNOITd.woff2
- https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/jetbrainsmono/v24/tDbV2o-flEEny0FZhsfKu5WU4xD7OwGtT0rU.woff2

Each family is accompanied by its SIL Open Font License from the corresponding
`google/fonts` repository's `ofl/<family>/OFL.txt`. Preserve those notices when
redistributing the embedded assets.
